svg.title: Linux page cache I/O lifecycle
svg.desc: An application's read and write calls pass through the VFS into the page cache, which serves hits from RAM, fills on misses, and marks writes dirty for later writeback. Only misses and writeback reach the filesystem, block layer, driver and device.

g.text: Folio state: clean → dirty → writeback → clean

svg.text: Coral arrows: device I/O, only on a miss or during writeback
